protocol.scope: Does a shared deterministic Boolean formatter exist for these supplied code streams? Not raw segmentation, key recovery or translation.
protocol.selection: No English score or model selection. Exact satisfiability per fixed family on68discovery books.
protocol.split: Existing exposed68/2 split; fit table only on discovery. Reserved prediction is conditional on imported codes and is not blind validation.
protocol.shuffle_policy: Permute annotated omission flags only among occurrences of the same code in the same book. Preserve imported code stream, per-book raw length and per-book/code omission counts. Raw copying can change.
protocol.copy_control_policy: One seeded random action per copied7-code window, using annotated per-code omission rates. Preserve code streams and force matching local contexts to use the same action. Raw lengths/counts only approximate the observation.
protocol.positive_policy: Construct one exact table per family, serialize the supplied code streams with it, and require the existence solver to find a compatible table.
protocol.no_statistical_claim: SAT/UNSAT is a logical compatibility test, no pvalues; repeated copies do not create independent evidence.
protocol.matrix_scope: code_phase16 covers any shared function of current code and fixed position in a16-code cycle reset at book start, hence any fixed orientation/phase relabeling of a4x4cell. Does not cover per-book unknown phases, other state, mixing or the full cipher.
protocol.upstream_relation: Extends prior zero-context probes with all fixed-stream alignments and exact arbitrary-table constraints; does not accept their semantic claims.
limits: Imported token sequence is fixed throughout and learned upstream on the public corpus. Alternative tokenizations are not excluded.
Nonlocal, randomized, framed, keyed, epoch-specific or book-specific formatters remain outside these families.
SAT lookup tables can memorize data; a fit is not a compact generative discovery, raw decoder or translation.
Control shuffles use one recorded ambiguous alignment; real contradictions use all compatible alignments.
Alignment/search caps yield unresolved, never rejection.
